newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain to spend $3 bln on development projects.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain to spend $3 bln on development projects.

text.p: Bahrain plans to spend 1.15 billion dinars ($3.05 billion) on development projects in the next four years, the Finance and National Economy Minister said on Tuesday.
"The government has allocated 1.150 billion dinars for vital development projects in an investment programme for the next four years," Ibrahim Abdel-Karim told the official Gulf News Agency.
Abdel-Karim said the investment programme was aimed at supporting economic activities and opening investment opportunities which would help find more jobs for citizens.
He said Bahrain would implement several infrastructure projects in the fields of electricity and water, transportation, roads, causeways, housing, health and education as well as building a new port.
The projects include a new power and water plant to produce 250 megawatts of electricity and desalinate 30 million gallons of water a day, he added.
It was not clear how Bahrain would finance the projects.
